mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.33%, it indicates restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS >= 5.33, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate and decreases in unemployment rate signal a late-cycle economic expansion with strong earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases > 0.1pp and UNRATE decreases > 0.1pp in past month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1pp and UNRATE falls > 0.1pp, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle regime with unemployment below 4.5%, labor market tightness accelerates inflation, prompting Fed rate hikes that reduce equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.5, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising housing starts series signals strong consumer demand and economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days through increased corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST increases, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 1350 thousand units, it indicates robust residential construction that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1350, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts and industrial production indicate broad economic strength that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 0.5% and INDPRO increases > 0.5% in past month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST and INDPRO both rise > 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index signals expanding manufacturing output and economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days through improved corporate earnings outlooks.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO increases, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
